name: dsh-video-background
description: Video/image background for DeepSeek Harness Web: an embedded media loop (plus user-picked files internalized to IndexedDB) plays behind the whole app — zoomed+blurred over the sidebar, opaque message bubbles keep text readable; a conversation-corner toggle with a popover offers dim strength, playback speed (50%-200% slider + direct input), a switchable/deletable media list and a file picker. The bundled video is base64-embedded, so deleting the source file never breaks the plugin.
